examples.name: Default
examples.summary: Mounted with `locale="pt-BR"`: Pagination and ConfirmDialog read their built-in labels in Portuguese and format numbers in the pt-BR style.

examples.name: CustomMessages
examples.summary: `messages` replaces one built-in string for the whole subtree; the rest of the catalog stays.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import { ptBR } from '@aziontech/webkit/locales/pt-BR'
  import PaginationRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/pagination-root'
  import WebkitProvider from '@aziontech/webkit/webkit-provider'

  const messages = {
    pagination: { info: '{start}–{end} de {total} domínios' }
  }
</script>

<template>
  <WebkitProvider
    locale="pt-BR"
    :catalogs="{ 'pt-BR': ptBR }"
    :messages="messages"
  >
    <PaginationRoot :total="48" />
  </WebkitProvider>
</template>

examples.name: RightToLeft
examples.summary: `locale="ar"` derives `dir="rtl"`: the subtree reads right to left and strings with no Arabic catalog fall back to English.
examples.sfc:
<script setup>
  import PaginationRoot from '@aziontech/webkit/pagination-root'
  import WebkitProvider from '@aziontech/webkit/webkit-provider'
</script>

<template>
  <WebkitProvider locale="ar">
    <PaginationRoot :total="48" />
  </WebkitProvider>
</template>
